messages:
Maya: Quick postmortem follow-up — RCA doc lists action items but a few need explicit owners and due dates. Can we confirm owners for infra, cache migration, and alert tuning? Link: <https://redwood.docs/postmortems/incident-2026-03-15|RCA-2026-03-15>

Tom: I can take infra / deployment rollbacks work. Suggest due: 2026-03-22. @Lina can you own alert tuning?

Lina: Yep, I can do alert tuning. Will triage alerts this week, aiming for 2026-03-19. Need confirmation on alert thresholds from SRE.

Sam: I can own cache migration (prefix-kv). ETA end of month unless blocked by model-owners for compatibility. Tentative due: 2026-03-31.

JG: Quick question — does cache migration block the rollback plan? If yes, we should prioritize. Also need a clear rollout plan (canary + metrics).

Maya: Good call. Tom, can you confirm whether rollback plan depends on cache migration? If yes, we move cache earlier.

Tom: Rollback doesn't depend on cache changes. Rollback is a fallback; cache migration is separate path to reduce load. So not blocking.

incident-bot: Postmortem doc updated by Maya. Actions table added: infra: Tom (2026-03-22), alerts: Lina (2026-03-19), cache: Sam (2026-03-31). <https://redwood.docs/postmortems/incident-2026-03-15/actions>

Maya: Ok I'll update the action tracker. Final ask: owners, please add a 1-line risk/rollback note to the actions table by EOD today. :thumbsup: 

Sam: Added my note: 'rollback to previous cache config if perf regressions >5%'.

Lina: Added.

Tom: Added. I'll also schedule a short cross-team sync tomorrow 10:30 to walk rollout steps.

Maya: Thanks — closing the loop. If anyone needs extra time, flag here. :white_check_mark:
